# autohotkey-test — Full Reference

AutoHotkey v2 scriptlet depot. 80+ AHK v2 scripts. HTTP bridge for remote
list/run/stop. Games, productivity tools, system utilities, dev tools.

Generated: 2026-07-05

## Architecture

```
User browser ──→ ScriptletCOMBridge.ahk (port 10744)
                     │
     ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
     ▼               ▼               ▼
  /run/:name     /stop/:name    /scriptlets
  Start-Process  Get-CimInstance  JSON list
  AHK64.exe      kill by cmdline  of 80+ scripts
```

The bridge is an AutoHotkey v2 script (ScriptletCOMBridge.ahk) that generates
a PowerShell HttpListener at startup. /run and /stop bypass the old batch files
and use direct PowerShell cmdlets.

## Bridge API

`http://127.0.0.1:10744` — PowerShell System.Net.HttpListener:

| Endpoint | Method | Response |
|----------|--------|----------|
| `/scriptlets` | GET | JSON array of {id, name, description, category, running} |
| `/run/{name}` | GET | "SUCCESS: Started {name}" or error |
| `/stop/{name}` | GET | "SUCCESS: Stopped {name}" or "INFO: {name} was not running" |
| `/dashboard` | GET | dashboard.html (dark-themed scriptlet browser) |
| `/status` | GET | "Server running" |
| `/exit` | GET | Shuts down the PS listener |
| `/restart` | GET | Restarts the PS listener via AHK watchdog |

### /run behavior
Uses `Start-Process -FilePath $ahkExe -ArgumentList $scriptPath`.
No console window. Game script opens its own GUI window.
Working directory is the bridge directory (autohotkey-test root).

### /stop behavior
Uses `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='AutoHotkey64.exe'"` then
filters by CommandLine matching the script name. Kills exact match only.
Bridge process (ScriptletCOMBridge.ahk) does not match the filter.

## Arcade Games

All use physical keyboard (no on-screen buttons needed in Wordle).
All hotkeys scoped with `HotIf` — they only fire when the game window is active.

### Classic Pong (`classic_pong.ahk`)
- GDI+ vector rendering (anti-aliased shapes, 60fps)
- Green paddles with rounded caps, white ball, dotted center net
- Controls: W/S or Up/Down move left paddle, Space=Start, P=Pause, R=Reset
- AI opponent with smooth pursuit
- Ball speed increases slightly per hit (1.02x)

### Tetris (`tetris_classic.ahk`)
- ASCII rendering (green on black), 20x10 board
- 7 tetrominoes (I, O, T, S, Z, J, L)
- Controls: Left/Right move, Up=Rotate, Down=soft drop, Space=Start
- Score tracking, level progression (speed-up every 500 pts)

### Frogger (`classic_frogger.ahk`)
- ASCII rendering, 9x7 lane grid
- 6 traffic lanes with scrolling cars
- Controls: Arrow keys to jump frog

### Pac-Man (`pacman_classic.ahk`)
- ASCII rendering, maze navigation
- Ghost AI, power pellets, score tracking

### Word Games (`word_games.ahk`)
- Tabbed: Wordle, Anagrams, Hangman
- Wordle: Physical keyboard (type letters, Backspace, Enter)
  - Green = correct position, Yellow = correct letter wrong position
  - Cheat (C button): suggests valid word from constraints
  - Super Cheat (S button): auto-solves entire puzzle
- Anagrams: Type unscrambled word into text field, click Guess
- Hangman: Press letter keys to guess

### Other games
- Q*bert (ASCII, arrow keys)
- Sudoku (click-to-fill grid)
- Chess (full board UI with Stockfish engine)
- Mini Games Collection (Snake, Reaction Timer, Number Guess)

## Hotfix: Text Color

All games with dark backgrounds (`BackColor` or `BackgroundXXXXXX`) now have
explicit text colors in their `SetFont` calls. Previously, many controls had
`Background000000` or similar dark backgrounds with no `c` option in `SetFont`,
causing the text to inherit the system default color (black on light theme,
making it invisible on the dark background).

Fixed files:
- classic_pong.ahk, tetris_classic.ahk, classic_frogger.ahk
- pacman_classic.ahk, qbert_game.ahk
- word_games.ahk, chess_stockfish.ahk, sudoku.ahk
- PuzzleGame.ahk, pacman_game.ahk
- mini_games_collection.ahk, ahk_launcher.ahk

## GDI+ Helper Library

`scriptlets/lib/GdipHelper.ahk` — minimal GDI+ wrapper for AHK v2:
- GdipHelper.Startup() / Shutdown()
- CreateBitmap() / GraphicsFromImage() / SetSmoothingMode()
- BrushCreateSolid() / FillRectangle() / FillEllipse()
- PenCreate() / DrawRectangle() / DrawLine()
- UpdatePicture(ctrl, pBitmap, w, h) — sets Picture control content
- Proper HBITMAP tracking and cleanup (no GDI handle leaks)

## start_dashboard.ps1

Fleet-standard launcher:
1. Finds AutoHotkey64.exe (checks common install paths)
2. Tests bridge liveness via TCP + HTTP GET /status
3. If not running, launches ScriptletCOMBridge.ahk and polls up to 20s
4. Opens http://127.0.0.1:10744/dashboard in default browser

## Justfile Recipes

| Recipe | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `lint-ahk` | Lint all scriptlets with linter_headless.ahk |
| `lint-fix` | Auto-fix v1→v2 issues with .bak backup |
| `lint-one name` | Lint a single scriptlet |
| `scan-compat` | v1→v2 compatibility scanner |
| `kill-ahk` | Kill all AutoHotkey64 processes |
| `dash` | Open dashboard in browser |
| `start` | Run start.ps1 |

## Port

`10744` — registered in mcp-central-docs/operations/WEBAPP_PORTS.md.
Frontend port `10747` for autohotkey-mcp web_sota (if running).
